title: Customer Success Manager
description: We're building the AI operating system for vets. Our AI agent Emma already runs client communication for clinics in 7 countries, including the largest veterinary groups in the world. As Customer Success Manager, you make sure every clinic gets the most out of Emma, from the first setup to the day they can't imagine working without her. About Vetpal There are more pets than ever, and fewer vets to care for them. Clinics are short on staff, vets spend half their day on admin, and their suicide rate is six times higher than average. We're building the AI operating system for vets. From the first phone call to the invoice, we give vets their time back, with the mission to bring pets, pet owners and their vets closer together. The role You own the relationship with our clinics once they've signed. You onboard new practices, set up Emma so she fits the way each clinic works, and become the person practice teams call when they have a question or an idea. You're the bridge between vets and our product: you explain a technical product in the language of everyday practice life, and you bring what you hear back to our engineers. You work closely with the founders and the rest of our CS team. Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase for its biggest deals. You'll report to Jan-Jaap van Helden. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

 

Your impact

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch.

This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. Fluent English. Nice-to-have Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS. A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience. Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics. What we offer A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats. Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds. A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy. Thursday socials to stay connected. A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days. About Eye Security Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. raw.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
raw.description:
Prevention Analyst - Pentesting

About this role


We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next.

That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go.

This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on.

This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end.

What you will do

  • Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective.

  • Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect.

  • Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice.

  • Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact.

  • Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on.

  • Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together.

  • Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients.

What you will need

  • Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications.

  • The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why.

  • Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one.

  • The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy.

  • A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player.

  • Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel.

  • Fluent English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS.

  • A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience.

  • Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats.

  • Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy.

  • Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr. We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons. As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You'll Do We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will: Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it. Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following. Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage. Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review. Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified. Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role 5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis. Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems. A data-driven mindset: you define metrics, build the tooling to measure them, and use them to argue for or against a change. Experience diagnosing hard-to-reproduce failures: flakiness, platform-specific behavior, memory and threading bugs. Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. Would be a Plus Familiarity with navigation concepts (map matching, dead reckoning, route progress, or Electronic Horizon). Experience with replay- or simulation-based testing using real sensor and GPS data. Hands-on experience building AI- or agent-based developer tooling for testing, code review, or triage. Experience with coverage tooling, performance benchmarking, or testing SDKs through generated bindings. Employment Requirements Employment Type: Full-time Weekly Hours: 40 h per week Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany) What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth. Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As a Senior AI Deployment Strategist, you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.

 

You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives.

 

What You Will Do

 

Strategic Advisory & C-Suite Partnership

• Serve as the lead strategic advisor for a portfolio of high-value enterprise clients, building trusted relationships with executive leadership (CEO, CTO, CIO).

• Lead C-suite workshops to diagnose business drivers and co-create multi-year AI transformation roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

• Develop and present compelling business cases and proposals, articulating the ROI of AI adoption and the value of Mistral’s platform.

 

Presales: Shaping the Vision

• Partner with sales and product teams to identify and qualify opportunities, positioning Mistral’s solutions as the catalyst for enterprise transformation.

• Design tailored AI strategies and proof-of-concepts that address critical business challenges and demonstrate tangible value.

• Act as a subject matter expert in client engagements, ensuring our solutions are understood, trusted, and adopted.

 

Postsales: Driving Deployment & Adoption

• Own the end-to-end success of AI deployments, from strategic planning to operational integration, ensuring solutions are embedded into the customer’s core workflows.

• Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results.

• Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success.

 

Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen. Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist. In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings. Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft. Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab. Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen. Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail. Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz. Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister. title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda. raw.description:

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

title: Senior Finance Manager Germany (m/w/d)
description: Zuschlag. Profit? Ein Tender ist gewonnen. Was nach Rabatten und Kosten bleibt, ist Ihre Frage. Als Senior Finance Manager Germany entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion eines wachsenden Generikageschäfts. Und sitzen mit am Tisch, bevor das nächste Angebot rausgeht. Für die deutsche Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers suchen wir eine zentrale Finance-Person in Frankfurt am Main. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Country Manager und dem Tender Management zusammen, rechnen selbst und bringen Ihre Empfehlungen in Geschäftsentscheidungen ein. ANDRIS Consulting begleitet die Besetzung als Personalberatung. Die Anstellung erfolgt direkt beim Auftraggeber, dessen Namen wir im vertraulichen Gespräch nennen. Aufgaben Geschäftsideen bewerten: Sie prüfen neue Produkte und Marketinginitiativen, rechnen Szenarien durch und erarbeiten mit dem Country Manager Empfehlungen für Investitionen. Nach der Umsetzung bewerten Sie die Ergebnisse. Gross-to-net verantworten: Sie gestalten die Prozesse rund um Krankenkassenrabatte und weitere Rabattprogramme, stimmen Forderungen ab und sorgen für nachvollziehbare Rückstellungen, Preisprüfungen und Freigaben. Tender wirtschaftlich gestalten: Mit dem Head of Tender Management prüfen Sie Angebotskalkulationen und machen sichtbar, wie sich Preise und Kosten auf die Marge auswirken. Reporting und Prozesse entwickeln: Sie erkennen Risiken früh, leiten Verbesserungen ab und begleiten deren Umsetzung, auch gemeinsam mit Supply Chain, Qualität und Logistik. Planung und Liquidität steuern: Sie gestalten Forecasts mit Vertrieb und Supply Chain. Treasury und die laufende Liquiditätsübersicht für Deutschland verantworten Sie gemeinsam mit dem europäischen Finance-Team. Das finanzielle Fundament sichern: Mit internen und externen Fachleuten stellen Sie Steuer- und Statistikmeldungen sicher, einschließlich Umsatz- und Körperschaftsteuer, und begleiten die Abschlussprüfung. Qualifikation Mindestens zehn Jahre Finance-Erfahrung, insbesondere in Business Finance oder Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A). Geschäftsnahe Finance-Aufgaben innerhalb von Pricing oder Tender Management sind ebenfalls interessant. Praktische Erfahrung mit der Finanzmechanik des deutschen Generikageschäfts: Gross-to-net, Krankenkassenrabatte, Rückstellungen und wirtschaftliche Tender-Bewertung. Auch eine frühere Generika-Station oder eine entsprechende Aufgabe im Pharmagroßhandel beziehungsweise Arzneimittelimport kann diese Grundlage bieten. Freude daran, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu durchdenken, Empfehlungen zu vertreten und deren Umsetzung zu begleiten. Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse, praktische Erfahrung mit SAP und die Fähigkeit, wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären. Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau, C1 bevorzugt, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Weiterführende Accounting- oder betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikationen und Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau von Prozessen sind willkommen. Benefits Finance für Deutschland entwickeln: Sie übernehmen lokale Verantwortung und gestalten die finanzielle Steuerung auf Basis vorhandener Prozesse weiter. Nah an Geschäftsentscheidungen: Sie arbeiten direkt mit dem Country Manager. An ihn berichten Sie vor Ort, fachlich an die europäische Finance-Leitung. Frankfurt am Main und Hybrid: Persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort gehört zur Aufgabe. Ergänzende Remote-Anteile werden anhand der Aufgabe und Ihrer persönlichen Situation abgestimmt. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht vorgesehen. Das Vergütungspaket besprechen wir im persönlichen Austausch. Was reizt Sie daran, Finance für Deutschland zu entwickeln? Bewerben Sie sich direkt hier über JOIN. Ein Anschreiben brauchen Sie für den Einstieg nicht. Wir behandeln Ihr Interesse vertraulich und melden uns für einen persönlichen Austausch. Christoph Andris ANDRIS Consulting · Pharma Executive Search Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann. Präsenz. Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Service mit Persönlichkeit
description: Du liebst persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Bei uns verbindest du ihn mit internationalen Aufgaben und der Chance, beruflich weiterzukommen. Wir sind Akademis, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsberatung. Wir helfen Familien, das passende Internat im Ausland für ihr Kind zu finden, und begleiten sie bei den nächsten Schritten. Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau suchen wir jemanden, der gerne telefoniert, aufmerksam zuhört und Freude daran hat, sich persönlich um Menschen zu kümmern. Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Sie schätzen eine Ansprechperson, die ihre Wünsche kennt, verständlich erklärt und zuverlässig nachfasst. Genau das lieben wir an unserer Arbeit: wenn aus einem ersten Gespräch eine vertraute Zusammenarbeit wird und Eltern wissen, dass sie sich auf uns verlassen können. Vielleicht arbeitest du bisher in der Hotellerie, in der Gästebetreuung oder im Kundenservice und möchtest deine Erfahrung in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen. Bei uns bist du als Quereinsteiger herzlich willkommen. Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf sind uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Verlässlichkeit und deine Freude daran, Familien und junge Menschen zu begleiten. Du möchtest dich einbringen und beruflich weiterkommen? Wir arbeiten dich persönlich ein und unterstützen dich dabei, deine eigenen Familien zunehmend selbstständig zu betreuen. In unserem kleinen Team kannst du Abläufe mitgestalten und mehr Verantwortung übernehmen. Mit deiner fachlichen Entwicklung und guten Leistungen soll sich auch dein Gehalt weiterentwickeln Aufgaben Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen. Beziehungen zu internationalen Partnerschulen pflegen: Du kommunizierst auf Englisch mit unseren Partnerschulen, klärst Fragen und stimmst Anforderungen und Abläufe ab. Dabei baust du persönliche Kontakte und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf. Eigene Projekte gestalten und umsetzen: Du übernimmst Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, bringst Ideen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit uns Abläufe. Ziele und Zuständigkeiten legen wir zusammen fest. Profil Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du hältst Zusagen ein, bringst Aufgaben nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig zum Abschluss und sprichst Schwierigkeiten frühzeitig an. Du denkst mit und packst an: Du erkennst, wo dein Beitrag gebraucht wird, unterstützt dein Team und möchtest unser kleines Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten. Eigene Ideen bringst du ein und hilfst dabei, sie umzusetzen. Du gehst neue Herausforderungen offen an: Du arbeitest dich engagiert in neue Themen ein, stellst gezielte Fragen und entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten weiter. Du verbindest Sorgfalt mit Tempo: Du arbeitest konzentriert und zügig, setzt Prioritäten und behältst parallele Anliegen im Blick. Unterlagen, Daten und Termine prüfst du gewissenhaft auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit. Du hältst Absprachen nachvollziehbar fest und kontrollierst deine Ergebnisse, bevor du sie weitergibst. Du berätst mit Einfühlungsvermögen: Du telefonierst ausgesprochen gerne, hörst aufmerksam zu und stellst dich auf unterschiedliche Menschen ein. Du nimmst die Wünsche und Sorgen von Eltern und Jugendlichen ernst und kommunizierst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen herzlich, klar und professionell. Du arbeitest an Lösungen: Du benennst Probleme klar, überlegst, was du selbst zu ihrer Lösung beitragen kannst, und beziehst rechtzeitig die Unterstützung ein, die du brauchst. Du bleibst respektvoll und direkt: Du sprichst Meinungsverschiedenheiten sachlich mit den Beteiligten an und trägst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen zu einer konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit bei. Du nutzt Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung: Du gehst offen mit eigenen Fehlern und sachlichen Rückmeldungen um, setzt berechtigte Hinweise um und gibst selbst respektvoll Feedback. Außerdem sprichst und schreibst du sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch und gehst sicher mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln um. Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Betreuung oder Organisation ist hilfreich. Unsere Partnerschulen und die Besonderheiten der Internatsberatung lernst du während deiner Einarbeitung kennen. Wir bieten Persönliche Einarbeitung: Wir begleiten deinen Einstieg. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Familien, Aufgaben und Projekte. Ein wertschätzendes Miteinander: Direkter Austausch, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Raum für Fragen und Ideen gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Klare Erwartungen und regelmäßige Rückmeldung: Wir vereinbaren konkrete Ziele für Betreuung, Organisation und Projekte und unterstützen deine Entwicklung. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eigene Ideen umsetzen, Abläufe mitentwickeln und mit wachsender Erfahrung weitere Verantwortung übernehmen. Karriere- und Gehaltsperspektiven: Wir möchten, dass du dich langfristig bei uns weiterentwickelst. Mit wachsender Kompetenz, guten Leistungen und zusätzlicher Verantwortung hast du die Möglichkeit, beruflich voranzukommen und auch dein Gehalt zu steigern. Deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte besprechen wir gemeinsam. Fortbildungen und internationale Einblicke: Du baust dein Wissen aus, arbeitest mit internationalen Partnerschulen zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, an internationalen Branchenveranstaltungen teilzunehmen. Eine langfristige Festanstellung: Du arbeitest 40 Stunden pro Woche, Montag bis Freitag, an fünf Tagen in unserem Büro in Berlin-Frohnau. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Industrial AI Venture, Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio company. About Marentis Marentis develops AI-supported software for manufacturing, robotics and complex automated machinery. We turn machine data and operational information into useful knowledge for troubleshooting, decision-making and automation. Our work connects sensor measurements, machine and robot states, quality data, alarms and expert knowledge. These problems require understanding both the data and its context: a fault may originate elsewhere in a production line, and similar symptoms can have different causes. We are a small, early-stage startup where individual contributions directly shape the product. We value curiosity, initiative and people who enjoy understanding difficult problems and making things work. The Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Engineer with strong Python skills and sound technical judgment. You will own backend features from problem definition through implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance. After onboarding, you should be able to investigate unfamiliar production code and independently review Python/backend pull requests: understand intended behavior, question assumptions, assess tests and failure paths, and identify effects on the wider system. We actively encourage AI-assisted development. You remain responsible for understanding, verifying and maintaining the resulting software. We value demonstrated delivery, ownership and learning ability more than a fixed number of years in the industry. What You Will Do Build backend services, APIs and SQL-backed data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows. Read and improve existing code, review pull requests, and make informed decisions about interfaces, data models, state and failure handling. Design meaningful unit, integration and end-to-end tests, supported by continuous integration. Test with representative machine data, recorded streams and simulated device inputs, including missing measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values and connection failures. Reproduce bugs, inspect whether test assertions verify the intended behavior, and add useful regression coverage. Understand manufacturing users and equipment, contribute across integration and deployment, and communicate trade-offs and blockers early. What You Bring Strong practical Python and backend engineering skills, supported by software you personally shipped and maintained. Independent code-review ability: you can investigate a change, assess correctness, maintainability and security, and justify whether it is ready to merge. Practical system-design judgment across APIs, SQL, database design, data validation, state management and concurrency where relevant. Strong testing and debugging skills: you choose useful test boundaries, construct representative data and investigate failures. Experience making imperfect operational, machine, sensor or similarly complex data trustworthy, with an interest in its industrial meaning and consequences. Resourcefulness: you learn unfamiliar code and technologies through documentation, small experiments, focused questions and feedback. Clear written and spoken English, constructive collaboration and reliable follow-through. We welcome different educational and professional paths. Direct manufacturing experience is especially useful; equivalent engineering depth from adjacent domains is also relevant. Particularly Relevant Experience Bring depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in all of them is not expected. Machine data, analytics and machine learning: Time-series or sensor-data processing, curation, feature engineering, anomaly detection, condition monitoring or quality prediction. Explain how you handled timestamps, units, asset identity and data quality, and evaluated whether the result was useful. Knowledge graphs and retrieval: Entity and relationship modeling, graph or relational database design, provenance, versioning and conflicting information. Experience combining identifiers, aliases, lexical search and semantic retrieval, with evaluations of relevance and applicability. Agent systems and workflows: LLM tools, multi-agent coordination, orchestration, context and memory management, validation and failure recovery. Show how you evaluated quality, cost and latency, enforced permissions and chose appropriate execution boundaries. Industrial integration, robotics and automation: Connecting software with production equipment, robot cells or automated machinery through telemetry, device interfaces or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA. Experience with simulators, physical-device testing and equipment-specific behavior is valuable. Cloud deployment, containerization, observability and operating software across customer environments are also useful. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later. Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs. Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate. How we work: AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production. Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence. Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital. Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints. Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog. Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage. What we’re looking for: Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team. Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count. Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes. Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code. Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required. Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team. Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act. What we offer Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow. Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals. Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities. Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement. Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories. Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany). Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones. Together: team meetups and company-wide events. Location We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. description: <h2>About The Opportunity</h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.</p> <h2>&nbsp;What To Expect?</h2> <ul> <li>You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus.&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li>Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Our Application Foundations group includes design systems &amp; information architecture, as well as workflows &amp; automation tooling, and search &amp; discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36.&nbsp;</li> <li>The Business Foundations group focuses on identity &amp; access, monetization, and platform insights.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li>You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.</li> <li>You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.</li> <li>You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally.&nbsp;</li> <li>Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Need To Be Successful</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.</li> <li>Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives.&nbsp;</li> <li>A strong customer-centric orientation. You ground design and product decisions in real customer insights and instill that same instinct across your team.</li> <li>A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.</li> <li>A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.</li> <li>Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfort operating in a technically complex, enterprise/platform context. The interfaces and user flows we design operate within a headless, API first context and a mindset of ‘systems thinking’ is paramount.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link:&nbsp;<a class="link__new-tab" href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.</strong></p> <h2>Unleash Your Potential</h2> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.<br><br>More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: <a href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a></p> <p><em>If you need reasonable accommodations at any point during the application or interview process, please let your Recruiter know.</em></p> <h2>Equal Opportunity Statement</h2> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal" target="_blank">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p><span style="color: #3e3e3e;"><em>Please be aware of scammers who may fraudulently claim to be from Contentful. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks &amp; Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&nbsp;</p> <div id="message-list_1777351501.983109"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote</span></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. small.<br><em><strong><br></strong></em><strong>What You’ll Do<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Move fast, with a process for consistently sourcing, tracking and maintaining a high volume of candidates while all facets of engineering - either software, hardware or both.</li> <li>3+ years of client interaction experience, including working with Hiring Managers and Directors, taking new requirements, reviewing profiles and updating pipeline progress</li> <li>Experience acting in a consultative manner where your guidance has led to improved outcomes, and a positive candidate experience, while earning the respect of your peers and clients</li> <li>Strong understanding of the technical skills and experience required for Engineering positions within the business</li> <li>Clear and effective communication with candidates to understand motivation, drivers, and fit within the organization</li> <li>Experience managing various funnels of candidates and keeping track of their progress throughout the recruitment process</li> <li>Working knowledge of applicant tracking and HRIS systems</li> <li>Working knowledge of interview techniques and applicant screening methods</li> <li>Familiar with a wide variety of sourcing avenues</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Startup, Tech, and relevant domain experience</li> <li>Are self-sufficient and are able to work with little direct supervision</li> <li>Resilient and creative – ideal candidates will be flexible enough to face routine obstacles, trouble shoot, and create a solution on the fly</li> <li>Attention and Communication – ideal candidates will be direct and succinct. They will share information in a timely and efficient manner, improving collaboration and productivity, while practicing active listening and engagement with intent</li> <li>Ownership – Be accountable for your universe and in tune with the business. Everyone on this team takes full responsibility for helping Anduril achieve its mission. That means seeking to improve all aspects of our company even in ways that are not explicitly part of our job while leveling up anything you can directly impact in realtime</li> <li>Low ego, high curiosity – Value learning over being right. Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey. The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine. Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. Presales: Shaping the Vision

• Partner with sales and product teams to identify and qualify opportunities, positioning Mistral’s solutions as the catalyst for enterprise transformation.

• Design tailored AI strategies and proof-of-concepts that address critical business challenges and demonstrate tangible value.

Postsales: Driving Deployment & Adoption

• Own the end-to-end success of AI deployments, from strategic planning to operational integration, ensuring solutions are embedded into the customer’s core workflows.

• Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results.

• Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success.

 

Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership

• Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth.

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. <h2><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.</li> <li>Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.</li> <li>Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.</li> <li>Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.</li> <li>Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program.&nbsp;</li> <li>Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash’s regulatory environment, not just document them.</li> <li>Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.</li> <li>Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re excited about you because you have…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track
