title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on&nbsp;the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory,&nbsp;you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals,&nbsp;quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization,&nbsp;inference engines, serving architecture, and&nbsp;benchmarking to improve&nbsp;latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while&nbsp;preserving&nbsp;quality and reliability.</p> <p>You&nbsp;will work with kernel and platform&nbsp;engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and&nbsp;resolve performance and quality&nbsp;regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through&nbsp;reproducible benchmarks and safe production&nbsp;rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization&nbsp;projects&nbsp;for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines&nbsp;and recommend serving configurations&nbsp;suited to individual&nbsp;workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and&nbsp;performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve&nbsp;LLM and VLM&nbsp;endpoint&nbsp;latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server,&nbsp;and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering&nbsp;quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.&nbsp;For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses&nbsp;measuring&nbsp;TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.&nbsp;Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate&nbsp;with GPU kernel and platform engineers to&nbsp;trace&nbsp;bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents,&nbsp;performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong&nbsp;engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer&nbsp;inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference&nbsp;stack,&nbsp;such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or&nbsp;an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong&nbsp;understanding of transformer inference&nbsp;bottlenecks involving&nbsp;KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to&nbsp;quantify trade-offs among&nbsp;latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and&nbsp;cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and&nbsp;collaboration skills across&nbsp;research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or&nbsp;SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or&nbsp;related&nbsp;inference acceleration methods.</li> <li>Experience&nbsp;supporting agentic workloads involving&nbsp;tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects such as&nbsp;vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or&nbsp;KServe.</li> <li>Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving&nbsp;- Bold thinking&nbsp;- Constant growth&nbsp;- Meaningful impact&nbsp;- Trust and real ownership&nbsp;- Opportunity to shape the future of AI&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.</p> <p>As a Software Engineering intern, you'll learn how we use OCaml (our primary development language) in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems. Some teams also use Python, so depending on the project, you might do some work with Python as well.</p> <p>During the internship, you'll be closely mentored by full-time software engineers. Mentors design intern projects based on their team's current needs and are heavily invested in helping interns build maintainable, high-quality software that is intended to reach production. The projects you will work on are as varied and diverse as those full-timers work on, covering a wide range of problems, from high-performance trading systems to programming language design and everything in between.</p> <p>If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/preparing-for-a-software-engineering-interview/">interview</a> and<a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/project-pairing/#fn:1"> team placement</a> processes and get a sense of what our <a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/tag/internship/">most recent intern projects</a> looked like! You can also learn more about Jane Street’s internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> <h3>About You</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>A top-notch programmer with a love for technology</li> <li>Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn</li> <li>Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!</p> <p>At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.</p> <p>Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.&nbsp;</p> <p class="Z7ph2">Read <a href="https://blog.duolingo.com/?utm_source=greenhouse.com&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=generalblog_gh_091224">our blog</a> to learn more.</p> <hr> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>About the role...</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;">We’re looking for a Senior Creative Director to set the creative vision for Duolingo’s brand building and marketing efforts and lead a team that delivers culturally resonant, high‑impact work across campaigns, social, partnerships, and user acquisition. You will raise the creative bar, turn bold ideas into clear concepts, and guide execution from brief through launch—collaborating closely with Brand Marketing and Growth, International Marketing, Product, Design, BD, and global agency partners to build an iconic brand with measurable business impact. Reporting to the Head of Brand Marketing, this role will lead other creative leaders in the Marketing function.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🧠&nbsp; You will...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive all creative work in the Marketing function, ensuring it consistently ladders up to the company strategy and moves key brand and business metrics.</li> <li>Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creatives; set a high bar for craft, narrative, and taste while creating space for diverse voices and experimentation.</li> <li>Turn great ideas into end‑to‑end campaign concepts; guide direction across channels (social, video, experiential, partnerships), from insight to execution.</li> <li>Partner with Brand Marketing to shape briefs, make strategic trade‑offs, and deliver work that’s part of culture and drives brand love and growth.</li> <li>Partner with Growth Marketing to build a performance marketing creative studio enabling our user acquisition efforts across the globe.&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner with our Country Marketing team to lead and evolve our global agency roster; ensure scopes, standards, and handoffs produce A+ creative worldwide.</li> <li>Oversee creative feedback and quality across all project stages; provide clear, timely decisions that keep momentum without sacrificing excellence.</li> <li>Inspire the organization with industry trends, creative references, and new platforms; codify what’s “on‑brand” and how we measure brand success.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>✅&nbsp; You have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in brand/creative roles with significant time leading other creative leaders; proven success shipping integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets at a high bar.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set vision, influence senior stakeholders, and connect creative decisions to strategy, KPIs, and ROI.</li> <li>A track record of turning insights into iconic, culture‑driving ideas and guiding multi‑disciplinary teams from concept to launch.</li> <li>Excellent communication and feedback skills; you simplify complex topics, make fast, sound calls, and bring others along.</li> <li>Experience managing agencies and external partners across markets, with a reputation for raising quality and speed.</li> <li>The ability to work from or relocate to New York City or London, UK</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>⭐&nbsp; Exceptional candidates will have...<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with IP-led brands</li> <li>Global brand experience, including creative leadership across multiple regions and cultures.</li> <li>A portfolio demonstrating world‑class craft and storytelling— work that drives buzz and earned media attention instead of relying on paid channels for distribution.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with social media and creator ecosystems, and how to translate cultural signals into breakthrough brand ideas.</li> <li>Experience establishing clear creative operating mechanisms with marketing, product, and design partners.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. title: Financial Advisory Graduate Programme
description: <h2>Teneo Financial Advisory</h2> <p>Teneo’s global Financial Advisory business advises corporates, creditors and other financial stakeholders in situations of financial stress and distress. No two situations are the same. Our advice and approach is tailored to each situation and each client. At Teneo, we believe such occurrences present new opportunities for our clients. Opportunities to restore value, raise new capital, pivot in a new direction and ultimately, identify certainty amidst chaos. Teneo partners with clients to find viable opportunities that will protect and enhance value and help them to build strategies that will most benefit their business and/or investment goals.</p> <p>Integrating the disciplines of financial advisory, management consulting, strategic communications, risk advisory and people advisory, Teneo’s global Financial Advisory team guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress.</p> <p>We help address the challenges a business faces, whether that is targeted performance improvement to financial performance, or delivering a route to recover value, our focus is delivering certainty from uncertainty.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</span></p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>Our programme offers a 3-year experience where you’ll work towards your chartered accountancy qualification while gaining invaluable experience across our Financial Advisory business. From day one, after your induction, you’ll dive into real-world projects, developing both technical expertise and broader business advisory skills.</p> <h2>Here’s what you can expect</h2> <ul> <li>Support senior colleagues with advising clients on commercial restructuring issues on several high-profile projects.</li> <li>Support a portfolio of insolvency appointments.</li> <li>Conduct market research, analyse data, and create insightful, clear reports and presentations.</li> <li>Produce high-quality deliverables within set timelines.</li> <li>Participate in client meetings and presentations, learning directly from experienced professionals.</li> <li>Build sector-specific knowledge and understanding.</li> <li>Maintain relevant qualifications and pursue further learning, including professional certifications.</li> </ul> <p>What sets our programme apart is the opportunity to rotate through our specialist teams, where you’ll explore key areas such as corporate turnaround, M&amp;A solutions, business valuations, and global capital markets, gaining a well-rounded foundation in financial advisory.</p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Achieved or on track for a 2.1 in any degree discipline from any UK university</li> <li>Graduating before September 2027</li> <li>Achieved a minimum of 136 UCAS points (or equivalent), including either Maths, a Science, Economics or Business Studies.</li> <li>Minimum GCSE English grade of 6</li> </ul> <h2>Application process</h2> <p>Stage 1: Online application and CV submission</p> <p>Stage 2: Online assessment</p> <p>Stage 3: In-person Assessment centre</p> <h2>Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion</h2> <p>We believe that different perspectives and new ideas are essential for us to meaningfully partner with our clients globally. We are committed to investing in our people and fostering an environment of dignity and respect to create a sense of purpose and belonging for all.</p> <p>In support of these objectives, we engage in targeted action to support our people, especially those from under-represented groups, in overcoming barriers and ensuring that each person is afforded the same opportunities to grow, develop and bring their whole self to work. We are taking active steps to build a culture of thinking, acting and leading inclusively that is embedded throughout our business.&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose You own the clinical bar across the Neko clinics in the North (currently Birmingham and Manchester) or South (currently London) regions of the UK. That means every consultation in your area meets the same threshold of safety, quality, and member experience across your region. It means the clinical teams working with you are developing, not just performing. It means clinical issues are being seen and addressed before they show up in audits or member complaints. And it means the quality metrics for your region are known, owned and moving in the right direction. And it means clinical judgment shows up at the table when operational decisions are being made. You'll partner closely with the UK Medical Director, who holds final clinical authority for the UK market, and operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager for your region who owns the operational side. The clinical health of the region is yours. What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months Hold the clinical standard across every site in your area Manage and develop the clinicians in your region: performance conversations, development plans, coaching, and the honest feedback that turns good clinicians into great ones. Ensure lead clinicians in your market(s) are performing excellently and that the clinical teams have the appropriate clinical escalation pathways in place. Support clinical hiring for your area against defined criteria, and partner with the Training and Education team to close training gaps as they emerge. Own the review and closure of clinical incidents and near-misses in your area, making sure learnings are actually applied, not just documented. Own the quality metrics for your region: accountable for performance against Neko's medical quality goals at area level, including scan quality (perfect scan score), member follow-up quality and timeliness (perfect follow-up score and follow-up SLAs), clinical safety (Northstar Clinical Safety score) and clinician summary quality and timeliness. Review the data with your Area Clinic Manager each week and month, trace variation to root cause by site and clinician, set improvement actions, and report progress and risks to the UK Medical Director. Operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager: co-owning quality, member experience, and business goals, attending and contributing to Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, and bringing clinical input into operational decisions before they're made. Round your sites regularly to observe, support, and listen, surfacing what's working so it can spread, and what isn't so it can be addressed. Build and maintain trusted relationships with the GPs, NHS trusts and private specialist clinicians who receive Neko referrals, monitoring referral quality and addressing breakdowns quickly. Know the UK regulatory landscape: CQC registration and inspection standards, GMC/NMC professional standards and revalidation, NHS and GP referral pathways and obligations, and UK-specific clinical rules, and flag emerging risks before they become problems. Lead or participate in clinical pilots as required - defining success, capturing learnings, and documenting outcomes so the rest of the company can learn from your region. What We're Hiring For Holds the Bar at Scale. You're the kind of clinical leader who can make sure every consultation feels the same regardless of site or clinician, not by micromanaging, but by setting a clear standard, coaching to it, and noticing when it drifts. You're rigorous without being rigid. Develops the Clinicians You Lead. You take clinician development seriously. You give honest feedback even when it's uncomfortable. You spot what someone needs before they ask. You know the difference between a clinician who needs coaching and one who needs to leave, and you don't avoid either conversation. The Dyad That Actually Works. You bring clinical judgment into operational decisions before they're made and you stay constructive when clinical standards and operational targets pull in different directions. When you escalate, it's because something genuinely needs leadership attention, not because you've stopped trying to resolve it locally. Reads the Pattern, Not Just the Report. You don't just review the data. You see what it's telling you. You round your sites and notice things that don't show up in dashboards. When you spot a pattern you trace it to the root cause and you make sure the right people hear about it. Trusted Outside the Walls. The referral network, the regulators, the specialist clinicians who receive Neko members: these relationships sit with you. You represent Neko credibly because you're a credible clinician yourself. People in the local medical community know your name, and when you flag something, they take it seriously. Minimum Requirements Full GMC registration with a license to practice, in good standing and with a current revalidation, and right to work in the UK. On the GMC GP Register with qualification (CCT or equivalent) in General Practice. 4+ years of medical leadership experience in the UK health system (NHS and/or private sector), including direct management of clinicians. Demonstrated experience holding clinical standards across multiple sites or a large clinical team. Preferred Experience in preventive care, tech enabled healthcare or longitudinal care models. Experience operating in a clinical-operational dyad structure. Experience leading clinical pilots or scaling new clinical workflows across multiple sites. title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. Your team You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. Your mission As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. What you will do Publisher integrations Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. Deals & catalog Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. Supply tooling & publisher platform Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
raw.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

Your team

You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about.

Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses.

Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access.

The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly.

Your mission

As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale.

What you will do

Publisher integrations

  • Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers.

  • Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory.

  • Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend.

Deals & catalog

  • Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API.

  • Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe.

  • Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it.

Supply tooling & publisher platform

  • Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend.

  • Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production.

  • Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design.

  • Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow.

  • Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break.

  • Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy.

  • Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables.

  • Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts.

  • Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value.

Nice to have

  • Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST.

  • Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels).

  • Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar).

  • Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Churn risks are flagged weeks ahead, and teams act on them before the renewal. Leadership plans on your renewal and NRR forecast You've turned the CRM into an expansion and pipeline generation tool, across lemlist and Claap. Your work contributes to a measurable lift in net revenue retention (NRR) on the managed portfolio. Sales and Partnerships see the difference too: clear rules of engagement, reliable routing, and partner deals credited and paid on time. Who you are 5+ years in RevOps or GTM Ops in B2B SaaS, ideally PLG + SLG. You've owned customer operations for a portfolio at scale (health scores, churn risk, renewal forecasting), and led at least one big change: a tool rollout, a new coverage model or a new customer segmentation. Sales or partner ops experience is a plus. Hands-on CRM admin experience (HubSpot) Experience with a customer platform (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat or similar) is a plus. Business sense: you turn data into a recommendation and defend it with senior stakeholders. You're used to working with VPs and the C-level, and you don't need a brief to start. Builder mindset: you automate, use AI daily, document what you build and close what you start. Fluent French and English. If you read our values and thought "this is 100% me", you'll thrive in this role. What is in it for you A senior role with real ownership in a small team: you shape how a $60M+ ARR company sells and grows its customers. You own the customer ops function Direct work with VPs, the COO and the CEO. AI by default: we already run AI agents on our CRM and internal tools, and we expect you to reach for AI first in everything you build. raw.description:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

raw.title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost

  • Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost

  • Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost

  • Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use

  • Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping

  • Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams

  • Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope

  • Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement

Candidate Profile:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work)

  • Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class

  • Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions

  • Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints

  • Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process

  • Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus)

  • Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing)

  • Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation)

  • Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware

  • Prior startup or skunkworks experience

Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will own our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

This is a role for an engineer who leads from the front because that is where the work is, not because management was the next rung on the ladder.

What You Will Do

  • Design and ship the control plane. You build alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software. You set the standard for ownership, remove the obstacles in their way, and coach them past their comfort zone until the work they ship surprises them.

  • Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am, and your engineers learn from how you do it.

  • Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback — the leadership work that never becomes someone else's job.

  • Define the team's processes and execution rituals as it grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

  • You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast.

  • You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on.

  • Extensive experience building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

5. Languages

title: AI Applied Scientist
description: About the Science and AI Team The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions. About the Role The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on. 1. Client projects Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs. Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention. Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence. Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on. Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live. 2. Testing scoring quality Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live. Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection. 3. Fairness in practice Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project. Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance. Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients. 4. Improving our scoring systems Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost. Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data. Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely. As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future. Our Ideal Candidate Required MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation. Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis. Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders. Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines. Preferred Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment. Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT. Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias. Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA. Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act. About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

 

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

     

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Saas Santé
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executive qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire. Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille. Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé déjà cartographiée. Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive. Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace. Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes. Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une première expérience de cold call intensive (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client. Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié. La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM. Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé. Nice-to-have Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé. La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection. Soft skills Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity . Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées. Bienveillance . Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien. Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents. 👥 Process de recrutement Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de deux exercices préparés à l’avance et la réalisation de deux exercices en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel. Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord. Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique. Compensation: €35K • €0 – €10.5K Commission • €35K • €0 – €10.5K Commission Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

  • Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

  • Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

  • Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

  • Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

  • Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

  • La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

  • Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

  2. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

  3. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. raw.title: Director, Customer Success
raw.description:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier.

 

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire - and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking - we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Customer Success to manage and scale a portfolio of strategic biopharma accounts. You'll own commercial outcomes for Top 25 biopharma customers, driving platform adoption, retention, and expansion to build a “business within the business”. Customer feedback from your portfolio will directly inform our product roadmap and operating model. You’ll operate with the judgment of an owner, not just execute a playbook.

What You'll Own

Commercial strategy

  • Own a portfolio of strategic biopharma accounts; drive the full commercial lifecycle - from implementation and onboarding through to retention and partnership expansion

  • Develop and execute account-level strategy, identifying expansion opportunities and leading renewal negotiations to achieve industry-leading retention rates

  • Monitor usage patterns, engagement signals, and business outcomes to proactively grow accounts and manage partnership signals

  • Transform satisfied customers into vocal advocates who provide references, case studies, testimonials, and speak at industry events

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Scientific teams, ensuring market feedback drives our product roadmap and strategic priorities

Lead Implementation and Drive Adoption

  • Orchestrate complex customer implementations including platform configuration, custom development, and data integrations aligned to customer use cases

  • Design and execute account-specific onboarding strategies, facilitating executive workshops, design sessions, and hands-on trainings that accelerate time-to-value

  • Proactively communicate product updates, new capabilities, and innovative use cases to maximize customer value realization

Provide Expert Technical Support

  • Diagnose and resolve platform issues through systematic troubleshooting, documenting problems clearly and coordinating with Engineering on appropriate resolution paths

  • Develop deep platform expertise that enables you to answer complex technical questions and guide customers through sophisticated workflows

  • Create feedback loops that ensure technical issues inform long-term product improvements

Who You Are

Essential Qualifications

  • 8+ years of customer success, management consulting, partnerships, account management, or implementation experience in pharmaceutical, biopharma, biotech, or life sciences industries

  • Working knowledge of drug development processes, portfolio management, and deal evaluation frameworks

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder decision-making within large enterprise organizations

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly master sophisticated software platforms and translate technical capabilities into business value

  • Exceptional executive communication skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where priorities evolve quickly

 

Bonus points

  • Direct experience in biopharma Search & Evaluation, Business Development, Licensing, Portfolio Management, or Strategy roles

  • Track record of driving measurable customer outcomes, achieving retention and expansion targets

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, advanced analytics tools, or decision intelligence software

  • Proficiency with customer success platforms (HubSpot, etc.)

  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MBA) in life sciences, business, or a related field

Location

We are strongly prioritizing candidates based in London (UK), Dublin (Ireland), or Basel (Switzerland) to support our EU-based clients. Today this role will be remote as we do not have a physical office in these locations, but as we scale, we intend to be hybrid 2x per week (Tues/Thurs).

 
 

Compensation: €89K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges

  • Dublin, Ireland • €89K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus
  • London, England • £85K – £110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus
  • Basel, Switzerland • CHF 117K – CHF 150K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Science Manager – Nature-based Solutions (80-100%)
description: As a Science Manager in Climeworks Solutions, you make sure that our nature-based solutions (NBS) portfolio meets the same demanding quality bar we apply to all our carbon dioxide removal offerings. Your focus is on Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (ARR), Improved Forest Management (IFM) and Mangroves, but you are not limited to these. You will screen the market, identify and assess priority projects, and carry out due diligence on potential partners. You form and defend Climeworks Solutions' own, independent scientific view on the quality, risks and fit of NBS projects. You keep our assessment criteria up to date and apply them in practice. You work closely with the sourcing team to shape our approach to nature credits, from first supplier contact to partnerships and product positioning. This role gives you real influence on how we build our nature offering and how the wider removal market develops. Quality framework development: You adapt and sharpen Climeworks' quality assessment frameworks for nature-based pathways. You draw on the newest published methodologies and on standards as they evolve. Supplier assessment and monitoring: You build constructive relationships with relevant suppliers. You rate and benchmark their projects. Over time, you track how project quality and delivery change and flag any concerns early. Project due diligence: You run in-depth technical, scientific and commercial reviews of key projects. These cover additionality, measurability, carbon accounting, co-benefits, reversal risk and delivery risk. You combine many data sources, including GIS analysis, project documents and registry information, into clear recommendations. Pathway segmentation: As the CDR industry matures, you group projects into sub-pathways and archetypes. For each one, you develop a well-founded view of what quality means. Market intelligence and prioritization: Together with Sourcing, you map the project landscape across key regions and pathways. You identify the strongest projects and recommend them, based on methodological robustness, pricing, reputation and delivery record. Contracting support: You help Sourcing draft contracts with approved suppliers. You focus on negotiating quality-related terms and amendments. Partnership development: You help build relationships with important players in the ecosystem, such as rating agencies, registries, NGOs and other opinion leaders. Pathway strategy: You work with colleagues in Science, Sourcing and the wider Commercial team to define the strategy for each nature-based pathway. You consider market trends, quality benchmarks, demand and supply. Sales support: You advise on project selection and answer technical questions in customer discussions, pitches and tenders. Knowledge sharing: You keep colleagues informed about scientific progress, new methodologies and market developments in nature-based solutions. Education: You have a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as ecology, conservation science, environmental or natural sciences, forestry or geography. A PhD is an advantage. Experience: You have hands-on experience in nature-based carbon projects. This could be project development, project design documentation, independent project ratings, MRV, carbon modelling or biodiversity research. Experience in carbon markets and CDR, and with standards such as Verra, Gold Standard, Plan Vivo or Isometric, is a strong plus. Analytical skills: You work confidently with large and varied datasets, including GIS and statistical analysis. You are precise and scientifically rigorous, and you can reach sound conclusions even when data is incomplete. Critical thinking: You question assumptions, spot inconsistencies and find practical solutions by connecting findings across projects. Business judgement: You weigh commercial and strategic factors when assessing projects and shaping strategy. Communication and language: You explain complex topics in a clear and credible way, and you can show how robust your assessments are. You are fluent in written and spoken English. Way of working: You take ownership and manage several projects at once, with clean documentation. You are comfortable working across teams and in different environments. You balance independent judgement with close collaboration. Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. What we offer: Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays. Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country. Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter. Family Support: Inclusive parental leave. Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth. Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team. Formalities:   This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week. The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you. We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.
